headline: Devyani International Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Reg. 31(4)
sum: Devyani International Limited submitted a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition to NSE, triggering mandatory open offer requirements under the Takeover Regulations, 2011.
detail: Devyani International filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), which requires public disclosure when a shareholder or concert party crosses the 25% threshold or makes a subsequent acquisition above the threshold. The filing was submitted to NSE on 24 June 2026. Material terms (acquirer, stake, price, conditions) are not disclosed in the available abstract.
